Messages.Author: Chris Shorb
Messages.Body:
PB Chicago text follows. My question is whether a Meth can choose the
option of moving zero blood to their pool, so that they don't have to
put blood on the 'base. We said yes, following things like Minion
Tapping for zero, etc.

Powerbase: Chicago
Cardtype: Master
Cost: 1 pool
Master: unique location. During your untap phase, you may move 1 blood
from the blood bank to the Powerbase or move all the blood on the 'base
to your blood pool. A vampire controlled by another Methuselah can move
all the blood on the 'base to his or her controller's blood pool

Thanks in advance.

Chris

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Chris Shorb wrote:
>
> PB Chicago text follows. My question is whether a Meth can choose the
> option of moving zero blood to their pool, so that they don't have to
> put blood on the 'base. We said yes, following things like Minion
> Tapping for zero, etc.

The Meth "may" do one of the two things: 1) move 1 blood to 'base or 2) take
all blood from 'base.

The Meth is free to choose not to do one of those two things, by virtue
of the "may". This is effectively the same as choosing 2) when there's
no pool on the 'base (which is also legal).

> Powerbase: Chicago
> Cardtype: Master
> Cost: 1 pool
> Master: unique location. During your untap phase, you may move 1 blood
> from the blood bank to the Powerbase or move all the blood on the 'base
> to your blood pool. A vampire controlled by another Methuselah can move
> all the blood on the 'base to his or her controller's blood pool
